title: 通胀传导：手机电脑价格，要涨？
speaker: Christina Woon

segments.en: We have inflation numbers out of the U.S. coming out. I'm just wondering, should we still be concerned about inflation here?
segments.zh: 美国通胀数据即将公布。我想知道，我们是否还需要担心通胀？

segments.en: Is it just the energy components or the energy side of things that you're worried about? What else should we be worried about when it comes to really the inflationary picture now?
segments.zh: 你担心的是能源部分吗？现在通胀形势中，我们还应该担心什么？

segments.en: Yeah, I think inflation is something we need to bear in mind. A lot of investors focus a lot on the energy side of things, all prices, et cetera.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为通胀是我们需要牢记的。很多投资者关注能源方面，比如油价等。

segments.en: But one of the things that we should be perhaps looking out as well in the current earning season is how that's flown through from a component perspective. And when I say component, I mean specifically within tech because that will weigh on things like consumer electronics, the end consumer to absorb any inflation from a tech hardware space, we've seen memory prices shoot up a lot this year and many investors have benefited from that as well.
segments.zh: 但在当前财报季，我们还应该关注的是通胀如何从零部件层面传导。我指的是科技领域，因为这将影响消费电子产品，最终消费者需要吸收科技硬件领域的通胀。今年内存价格大幅上涨，许多投资者也从中受益。

segments.en: But ultimately, that will also flow through into handphone prices, laptop prices, and things like that. And we will have to see whether the market will be able to absorb these prices as well.
segments.zh: 但最终，这也会传导到手机价格、笔记本电脑价格等。我们将不得不看看市场能否消化这些价格。

segments.en: So that's one of the other areas I would keep in mind.
segments.zh: 所以这是我会关注的另一个领域。
